headline: CLE @ HOU matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CLE 4.05 at HOU 4.36, with a projected total of 8.41. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (CLE +0.27, HOU +0.39), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.72, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -9.7%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Tatsuya Imai has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Yordan Alvarez, Cam Smith, Christian Walker, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Rhys Hoskins, Stuart Fairchild because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
